bank: Disjoint IID groups from the full frozen independent-trip posterior; no corridor pruning.
prefix: All physical platform actions; stop at first ridden connection or fixed elapsed horizon.
tail: Full-graph clairvoyant station-MCT scan respecting current transfer phase.
interpretation: Each bank optimum is downward biased for the population causal-prefix optimum. The paired increase also includes delaying physical relaxations, not only information value. Singleton support measures accidental identification in a sampled bank.
budget: A node-budget failure yields no value. Stop further banks for that root/horizon; retain the failed work and do not compute population summaries for incomplete panels.
inference: Optional e-mixture lower bounds use independent bank optima and disjoint world losses; alpha=.05/(3 roots * 2 horizons * 2 estimators). These are not claims about real traffic.
